To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the linker region of matrix metalloproteinases influences their interactions with collagen, and this is important for MMP-catalyzed degradation of collagen and tissue remodeling.
(1) the linker region of human MMP-1 is essential for MMP-1 catalysis and (2) the linker region is important for collagen binding to MMPs.
MMP-1 is a highly flexible enzyme and that the linker region of the enzyme plays an important role in MMP-1 catalytic activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamics of MMP-1, and how the dynamics are influenced by the conformational changes in the linker region.
the role of the conformation of the linker region on the dynamics of the interactions between MMP-1 and collagen.
the role of the flexible linker region of MMP1 on the dynamics of the MMP-1 domains and interactions with THP.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the linker region of the MMP-1 influences its catalytic function.

the dynamics of the MMP-1 domains and the THP are highly correlated and that the linker region plays a critical role in the interactions of the CAT domain with the THP and in the interactions of both domains with the THP.
the linker region of the MMP-1 plays a key role in the dynamics of MMP-1 and collagen binding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the linker region plays a critical role for the function of MMP-1, and the dynamics of the CAT and HP-X domains are correlated with one another and with the linker region.
the linker region plays an important role in collagenolysis by MMP-1, and the linker regions from MMP-13 and MT1-MMP have the potential to alter the dynamics and interactions of MMP-1 with collagen.
the linker region of the MMP-1 influences MMP-1 function by modulating both the dynamics and interactions between MMP-1 domains.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the linker region of the MMPs is important for the interactions of the CAT and HP domains with the substrate, which is critical for the MMPs' ability to cleave collagen.
the linker region of the MMP-1 is an important determinant of the MMP-13/MMP-1•TH complex dynamics.
the linker region of the MMP-1 plays an important role in collagen binding and the catalysis of MMP-1.
